fresh_source_review.summary: Read all 48 represented positions (3–50), including the wholly obscured openings on images 98 and 99, against full pages and enlarged five-row bands. Retained the source-specific terra, tentative Nonne sit, non eris, Deliciis inpleto, et ligature and all conservative damaged fragments. Restored the clear terminal point after pudicas at 13. The large lexical T at 39 remains described without inventing an underlying state. The primary description and intervening source material confirm the separate absence of 1–2.
